passages.text: A commercial invoice must carry a specific goods description; 'samples' or 'spare parts' alone is insufficient for classification.
Where the declared value exceeds the de-minimis threshold of the destination, a formal entry is required.
Country of origin must be stated per line item, not per shipment.
Under DAP terms the recipient settles duty and tax before release.
Under DDP terms the shipper is billed for duty, tax and the associated handling fee.
Express services are measured against an end-of-day commitment on the stated transit day.
Economy services carry no time-of-day commitment.
An in-transit address change is permitted within the destination country, once per shipment.
Address changes are not permitted after the first delivery attempt.
A scan gap of up to 72 hours is normal during international line-haul movement.
An exception scan always carries a reason code; the absence of a scan is not itself an exception.
Fragile goods require a double-walled outer box.
Cushioning must be at least 5 cm on every face, and the contents must not shift when the box is shaken.
Devices containing lithium batteries must be declared.
Loose lithium cells may not travel by air under standard service.
Volumetric weight is length x width x height in centimetres divided by 5000.
The greater of actual and volumetric weight is used to rate the shipment.
A disputed invoice line must be raised within 30 days of the invoice date.
Payment of undisputed lines is expected while a dispute is open.
A return label remains valid for 30 days from issue.
Returns are consigned to the merchant's nominated address, not the original origin.
Dangerous goods require a shipper's declaration and trained acceptance.
Consumer aerosols are restricted by air and may travel by road only.
Goods entering temporarily for exhibition may use an ATA Carnet.
A Carnet must be presented at both entry and exit.
Proof of delivery includes the delivery timestamp and, where captured, the signatory name.
A photo of placement is captured where no signature is required.
A collection booked before the daily cut-off is serviced the same business day.
Saturday collection requires a premium service.
A remote-area surcharge applies to postcodes listed in the annual schedule.
Fuel surcharge is revised monthly and applies to the base rate.
